content.value_statement: Building a ChatGPT app requires coordinated MCP tools, React views, authentication, testing, and deployment. This skill guides the complete Skybridge workflow from discovery through publishing.
actual_capabilities: Guides product discovery and records requirements in SPEC.md.
Designs MCP tools, custom views, and conversational user flows.
Scaffolds TypeScript Skybridge projects with supported package managers.
Implements React views, shared state, model context, and responsive display modes.
Configures OAuth providers, CSP allowlists, external links, and file downloads.
Supports local testing, model evaluations, Alpic deployment, and directory submission.
limitations: Requires an existing development environment and access to the selected package manager.
Uses Skybridge-specific APIs and does not provide framework-neutral MCP guidance.
External services, OAuth providers, and deployment platforms require separate accounts and credentials.
Live model evaluations can incur provider costs and require API keys.

use_cases.title: Prototype a ChatGPT app
use_cases.description: Turn a focused product idea into a specification, MCP tool design, and interactive React view.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers building a first conversational app

use_cases.title: Add secure user data access
use_cases.description: Configure OAuth, tool permissions, scopes, and authenticated handlers for user-specific workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare an app for release
use_cases.description: Run local checks, model evaluations, deployment steps, CSP audits, and directory submission tasks.
use_cases.target_user: Teams moving a Skybridge app into production

prompt_templates.title: Explore an app idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define a ChatGPT app for [audience]. The main problem is [problem]. Ask one discovery question at a time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery before a specification exists

prompt_templates.title: Design tools and views
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SPEC.md. Design focused MCP tools and React views for [workflow]. Explain which steps need custom UI.
prompt_templates.scenario: Architecture planning for an existing specification

prompt_templates.title: Implement authenticated data access
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [OAuth provider] authentication to this Skybridge app. Protect [tools] with [scopes] and keep [public tool] anonymous.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and release the app
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Skybridge app for tool annotations, CSP, responsive views, authentication, evaluations, deployment, and directory submission. Fix verified issues.

output_examples.input: Design a flight search app from an approved specification.
output: A search tool accepts destination and dates.
A results view compares flights and preserves selection state.
A checkout tool returns an approved external redirect.

output_examples.input: Add authentication while keeping public search available.
output_examples.output: The app uses a configured OAuth provider, leaves search anonymous, protects account tools, and checks required scopes before returning user data.

output_examples.input: Prepare the app for directory submission.
output_examples.output: The review verifies annotations, declared CSP domains, ownership setup, responsive display modes, authentication behavior, and successful local evaluation results.

best_practices: Keep SPEC.md current before changing architecture or implementation.
Expose concise model data while keeping large display-only payloads in view metadata.
Verify authentication, tool annotations, CSP domains, and responsive layouts before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not port an entire application when a few focused conversational actions are sufficient.
Do not place secrets in model-visible content, view metadata, logs, or committed files.
Do not duplicate the same payload across content, structured data, view state, and model annotations.

faq.question: What does this skill build?
faq.answer: It guides development of ChatGPT apps and MCP servers with Skybridge, TypeScript, and React views.

faq.question: Does it support existing projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update a project with an existing SPEC.md and guide supported Skybridge migrations.

faq.question: Can it add authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers built-in OAuth providers, custom providers, mixed public and protected tools, scopes, and manual verification.

faq.question: How are applications tested?
faq.answer: The workflow supports local DevTools checks and behavior-focused evaluations that call a real language model.

faq.question: Which deployment path is documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents Alpic CLI deployment, local tunneling, and connection steps for ChatGPT and Claude.

faq.question: Will evaluations use paid services?
faq.answer: They can. Live evaluations require a supported model provider, an API key, and may create usage charges.
